title: AI Functions require Databricks Runtime 17.3 LTS or above
body:
Beginning in January 2027, AI Functions that require Databricks Runtime 15.4 LTS or above, other than `ai_similarity`, require Databricks Runtime 17.3 LTS or above. Calls to these functions on Databricks Runtime versions below 17.3 are no longer supported and return an error.

Upgrade the compute that runs affected SQL queries to Databricks Runtime 17.3 LTS or above before support ends. This change does not affect the AI Functions REST API.

See [Transform unstructured data using AI Functions](/aws/en/large-language-models/ai-functions).
